creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/FM/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_defense/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python) and Node 24 (v24.12.0 used). render.py runs studio/audio/cli.mjs on score.json; the output parent directory must exist.
patch: Studio audio score, MT19937 seed 6401 (per note [seed, event, layer]). Voices: low drum (sine with a short pitch scoop plus an octave partial) on beats 1 and 3; stone ostinato (four-partial additive pluck, A2-G3) in eighth notes with rests; wave bell (FM sine, ratio 2, index 0.3) at the end of every eighth bar; shaker (6-10.5 kHz band noise) in bars 17-28; low-passed saw plus sub-sine drone A1+E2, then D2+A2 from bar 17. Seeded-noise impulse reverb 1.5 s, wet 0.22, folded across the loop boundary.
tuning: A minor pentatonic (A C D E G), tonal center A; A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: The 1.6-5 kHz band that carries the enemy tells holds -47.31 dB of total energy. Measured mono energy share (engine bands): 0-100 Hz -3.9 dB, 100-450 Hz -2.31 dB, 450-1600 Hz -23.11 dB, 1600-5000 Hz -47.31 dB, 5000-22050 Hz -43.38 dB.
structure: 32 bars at 96 BPM in four eight-bar groups. The drum plays every bar (the bass moves to D on bars 3-4 and E on bar 7 of each group). The ostinato plays bars 1-7 of each group and rests in bar 8, where the wave bell calls (bars 8, 16, 24, 32), so a wave call and the enemy tell have room; bars 30 and 31 also rest so the loop ebbs before it wraps. The shaker adds off-beat ticks in bars 17-28. Every voice except the two drones enters an eighth note after the loop start, so frame 0 is not a note onset (a first version that began on a drum onset failed the Ogg three-repeat seam rule; this pickup fixed it); the last bell note of bar 32 therefore wraps onto the start of the next pass.
proposal: Tempo, length, loop point and structure are the author's proposal (docs/AUDIO_DESIGN.md, 'Modes proposal'); the project owner settled only the one-sentence brief of the mode and the order to go ahead.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: Notes, drone and reverb tails wrap modulo the loop; frame 0 continues from frame loopEnd - 1.

verification.rebuild: Rendered by the Studio audio engine; render twice gives byte-identical WAV (tools/tests/test_audio_modes.py rebuilds into a scratch directory and compares).
verification.meter: Studio audio engine measure (BS.1770 K-weighted LUFS, 4x oversampled true-peak estimate); pack evidence re-measures with the pinned FFmpeg 6.1.1 ebur128.
verification.scale_check: Every pitched note is inside the declared pentatonic (key.enforce true; the engine raises out_of_scale otherwise).
